infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: feathertune remote talks to your PC over your home network to show what it plays and to send play, pause, next and volume. It never leaves your network.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: feathertune remote uses the camera only to scan the pairing code shown by feathertune on your PC. Nothing is recorded or saved.
